from control import *
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
axes=np.array(s['proprio']['axis']);positions=np.array(s['proprio']['position_m'])
def transform(q,side='left',tip='palm'):
 inds=[11,12,13,14,15,16,17] if side=='left' else [40,41,42,43,44,45,46]
 an=[11,12,13,14,15,21,22] if side=='left' else [16,17,18,19,20,41,42]
 T=np.eye(4)
 for j,a in zip(inds,an):
  rot=Rotation.from_rotvec(axes[j]*q[a]).as_matrix();U=np.eye(4);U[:3,:3]=rot;U[:3,3]=positions[j]-rot@positions[j];T=T@U
 pt=np.array([.425,.214 if side=='left' else -.214,.087]) if tip=='palm' else np.array([.55,.247 if side=='left' else -.247,.087])
 return T[:3,:3]@pt+T[:3,3],T[:3,:3]
def ik(target,q,side='left',tip='palm',forward=None,up=None):
 inds=np.array([11,12,13,14,15,21,22] if side=='left' else [16,17,18,19,20,41,42])
 def err(x):
  a=q.copy();a[inds]=x;p,R=transform(a,side,tip);e=list((p-target)*4)
  if forward is not None:e.extend((R[:,0]-forward)*.5)
  if up is not None:e.extend((R[:,2]-up)*.5)
  e.extend((x-q[inds])*.015);return e
 fit=least_squares(err,np.clip(q[inds],ranges[inds,0]+1e-6,ranges[inds,1]-1e-6),bounds=(ranges[inds,0],ranges[inds,1]),max_nfev=300)
 a=q.copy();a[inds]=fit.x;print('ik',np.round(fit.x,3),transform(a,side,tip)[0],fit.cost);return a

cat > /app/output/vision.py <<'PY'
import cv2,numpy as np
from control import *
def locate(o,seed=(40,140),show=False):
 L=o['images']['left_eye_camera'];RR=o['images']['right_eye_camera'];gray=cv2.cvtColor(L,cv2.COLOR_RGB2GRAY)
 mask=((L.min(2)>115)&((L.max(2).astype(float)-L.min(2))<18)).astype('uint8');n,labels,stats,cents=cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats(mask)
 print([(tuple(st),tuple(np.round(c,1))) for st,c in zip(stats[1:],cents[1:]) if st[4]>30])
 candidates=[i for i in range(1,n) if stats[i,4]>30 and stats[i,4]<5000 and stats[i,3]>30]
 if not candidates:return None
 idx=min(candidates,key=lambda i:np.linalg.norm(cents[i]-seed));cx,cy=cents[idx]
 stereo=cv2.StereoSGBM_create(minDisparity=0,numDisparities=128,blockSize=5,uniquenessRatio=5,speckleWindowSize=50,speckleRange=2,disp12MaxDiff=1,P1=8*25,P2=32*25)
 d=stereo.compute(gray,cv2.cvtColor(RR,cv2.COLOR_RGB2GRAY))/16.
 selected=labels==idx;v=d[selected];v=v[(v>1)&(v<120)];disp=np.median(v);dist=(128/np.tan(np.deg2rad(22.5)))*.06/disp;f=128/np.tan(np.deg2rad(22.5))
 pt=np.array([.1+dist,.03+(128-cx)*dist/f,.65+(128-cy)*dist/f]);print('HANDLE',cx,cy,disp,pt)
 return pt
if __name__=='__main__':locate(r.observe())

from control import *
def pole(im):
 gray=im.mean(2);yy=np.arange(5,245);best=None
 for slope in np.arange(-.6,.61,.03):
  xx=np.round(np.arange(256)[:,None]+slope*(yy[None,:]-125)).astype(int);valid=(xx>=16)&(xx<240);xxc=np.clip(xx,16,239)
  vals=gray[yy[None,:],xxc];le=gray[yy[None,:],xxc-15];ri=gray[yy[None,:],xxc+15];qual=valid&(vals>105)&(le<95)&(ri<95)&((vals-le)>22)&((vals-ri)>22)
  counts=qual.sum(1);x=counts.argmax();score=counts[x]
  if best is None or score>best[0]:
   ys=yy[qual[x]];xs=xx[x][qual[x]];best=(score,x,slope,ys,xs)
 if best[0]<25:return None
 score,x,slope,ys,xs=best;return {'count':int(score),'x':float(np.mean(xs)),'y':float(np.mean(ys)),'intercept':int(x),'slope':float(slope),'ys':ys,'xs':xs}

  offs=np.arange(-5,6);a=gl[ys[:,None],xs[:,None]+offs];b=gr[ys[:,None],xs[:,None]-d+offs];ma=a-a.mean();mb=b-b.mean();ncc=np.sum(ma*mb)/(np.linalg.norm(ma)*np.linalg.norm(mb)+1e-8);error=np.mean(np.abs(a-b));ds.append((error-10*ncc,d,ncc))

 if verbose:print('pole', {k:v for k,v in p.items() if k not in ['ys','xs']},'matches',ds[:3],'target',pt)
